verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for an analytics SaaS that holds customer data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no setting or policy that stops GA4 data from being used to train AI models. The pack covers only adjacent controls, such as data-retention settings (docs-16) and the User Deletion API (docs-30), which earn no credit for this story. Marketing material (docs-37) says Google's machine learning is applied to your data but offers no opt-out from training.
